notes.title: “THOSE GAMES EXTREME” is now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5gwqJ8rAgG0;full][/previewyoutube]
Pushing the envelope! The third in the series, [b]“THOSE GAMES EXTREME”[/b] is now available!

Play upgraded, more difficult versions of familiar minigames to your heart's content!

THOSE GAMES EXTREME is a minigame collection that ramps up the difficulty and fun factor!
Play upgraded, harder versions of minigames from [b]THOSE GAMES 1 and 2[/b]!
Take on the minigames you know and love, now with a whole new layer of hardcore challenge and replayability!

Purchase during the first 14 days of launch to receive [b]20% off[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246190/

[h3]Includes 155 stages of 6 types of mini-games![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392250/99eef0d18e1976edc12bf4f2f426d91d3af6a183.jpg[/img]

Featuring new versions of THOSE GAMES staples, all with updated visuals, including [b]Pin Pull, Number Tower, Color Lab, Knock-Back Shooter, Draw & Guard[/b], and Spellbinding Scroll (now upgraded to [b]Survival Scroll[/b]!).

Are you ready for the hardest instalment in the THOSE GAMES series yet? Are you ready...for THOSE GAMES EXTREME?!

“LISTEN UP! WE TRIED TO MAKE “THOSE GAMES” EVEN MORE EXTREME! SOME THINGS HAVE TO BE LEARNED THE HARD WAY!” is now available for purchase on Steam.
